packageRules.description: Devcontainer features are versioned as major-only docker tags (:1) and pinned by .devcontainer/devcontainer-lock.json, which Renovate cannot update; refresh them by hand with `devcontainer upgrade` instead of getting no-op PRs
One PR for all Helm chart bumps: they are reviewed together against the release notes and applied in one stack-standup run
One PR for all container image bumps (chart values defaults and the tfvars/inventory pins share this group, so mirrored pins move together)

OCI-hosted Helm charts must use the docker datasource (the helm datasource cannot serve oci://), but they are charts: group them with the Helm charts, not with container images. Placed after the Docker images rule so it wins

Automerge patch/pin/digest updates only once the CI workflow's check runs are green. platformAutomerge is off globally: GitHub auto-merge is disabled on the repo (allow_auto_merge=false) and, if it were enabled without a ruleset requiring the CI checks, GitHub would merge before CI finishes. Renovate-native automerge merges only when every check run on the PR passes and internal renovate/* statuses are not the only checks (internalChecksAsSuccess=false), so the CI workflow must produce at least one check run on every Renovate PR (path filters inside jobs, never on.pull_request.paths)

Group Kubernetes-related updates (k3s, Gateway API CRDs, kubectl binary/image) into one Monday-morning PR because k3s bumps are a node-rolling event. Regex form because minimatch globs never cross '/' (the old 'kubernetes**'/'k3s**' globs matched nothing). The datasource filter keeps the pypi kubernetes client, the kubernetes.core collection and the hashicorp/kubernetes provider out. Cron schedule (Mon 00:00-09:59 in `timezone`) only gates branch creation; existing branches still rebase

kubectl must stay within +/-1 minor of the k3s cluster (k3s_version 1.36.x in inventory/production/group_vars/k3s_cluster/main.yml). Raise the ceiling when k3s moves to a new minor; tests/renovate/test_config.py asserts it equals <1.<k3s_minor+2>.0
Group Cilium updates into one Monday-morning PR: a CNI bump disrupts every node and is applied in the same window as k3s. Regex form for parity with the Kubernetes rule

ghcr.io, quay.io and mcr.microsoft.com return no release timestamps (only Docker Hub does), so under the global minimumReleaseAge + timestamp-required their updates were parked in 'Pending Status Checks' until someone ticked the dashboard checkbox. Disable the age check for them so they get PRs like everything else

k3s.orchestration is pinned to a git tag of k3s-io/k3s-ansible (requirements.yml, git-tags datasource): git ls-remote returns no timestamps, so under the global minimumReleaseAge (timestamp-required) every new k3s-ansible tag would sit in 'Pending Status Checks' forever. Public-only rule: the private repo has no git-tags dependency

required_version is a floor, not a pin: bumping '>= x' on every Terraform patch release is noise (private PRs #150 #180 #190 #194, public #119 #123 #124 #126 were one-line churn) and, being typed 'patch', would automerge a raised minimum CLI version for every operator. Bump it by hand when a feature is needed; providers are still updated via required_providers

chart_versions.gateway_api is not consumed: Gateway API CRDs are rendered from oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-crds-helm at chart_versions.envoy_gateway (h3xinfra/playbooks/07-gateway/standup.yml). Stop generating PRs for it until the pin is removed; delete this rule together with the pin
One PR for all GitHub Actions digest/version bumps (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps the SHA + '# vX.Y.Z' comment current); separate PRs per action would eat the prConcurrentLimit

One PR for CI tooling: tests/tool-versions.env tool pins, tests/requirements.txt python pins and any env pins in workflows. Last rule so it wins over the datasource groups for files under tests/; matchManagers keeps the github-actions group separate

customManagers.description: Generic `# renovate: datasource=… depName=… [packageName=…] [registryUrl=…] [extractVersion=…] [versioning=…]` marker (attributes in any order) above a `key: value`, `key = "value"`, `KEY=value` or Dockerfile `ARG KEY=value` line. Covers inventory versions.yml and inventory.example.yml (mirrored pins update together), terraform *.auto.tfvars, tests/tool-versions.env and other tests/ files, env pins in GitHub workflows, ARG pins in .devcontainer/Dockerfile and the tool pins in scripts/h3xinfra-setup-dependencies. Blank and plain comment lines between marker and key are tolerated (RE2 has no lookahead, so a second `# renovate:` marker or a commented-out key in that gap would be mis-attributed: tests/renovate/test_config.py forbids that)

k3s version pinned in the Ansible inventory (k3s_version key, k3s+build regex versioning so v1.36.4+k3s1 -> +k3s2 is a patch and -rc tags are ignored). Same comment-tolerant tail as the generic manager; inventory.example.yml is handled by the generic manager to avoid duplicate extraction

hostRules.description: helm.cilium.io is slow to serve its large index.yaml; Renovate's default timeout is already 60000 ms (60 s), so anything lower would shorten it
ghcr.io tag listings for the OCI charts/images pinned here are paginated and occasionally slow; raise above the 60000 ms default (the previous 30000 halved it)
